spans.s: षहसानु m. 1. A peacock; 2. a sacrifice.

सह् (I) vt. 1Ā (sometimes also Par.) (the initial स् of this root is changed into ष् after नि, परि and वि) (pp. सोढ; pres. सहते) 1. To bear, to suffer, to endure, to undergo, सहंते संतापं तदपि धनिनां द्वारि कृपणाः Bhartr.ii.(misc.)28; 2. to allow, क्रूरस्तस्मिन्नपि न सहते संगमं नौ कृतांतः Megh.ii.42; 3. to forbear, प्रियः प्रियायार्हसि देव सोढुम् Bg.xi.44; 4. to be patient, to wait, R.v.25; 5. to be able to resist, to conquer, to oppose, to stop; 6. to be able, (with an inf.).With उद्-, 1. to make an effort or exertion, Bt.xix.16; 2. to dare; 3. to be able, कथं कनीयानहमुत्सहेय Bt.iii.54; 4. to desire, to be inclined to, to be disposed to, तवानुवृत्तिं न च कर्तुमुत्सहे K.S.v.65.With प्र-, 1. to make an effort; 2. to endure, न तेजस्तेजस्वी प्रसृतमपरेशां प्रसहते Ut.vi.; 3. to overpower, संयुगे सांयुगीनं तमुद्यतं प्रसहेन कः K.S.ii.57; 4. to be able.With वि-, 1. to sustain, R.iv.49; 2. to endure, R.iii.63; 3. to be able to resist; 4. to determine.
सह् Caus. (साहयति-ते) to cause to bear, to cause to endure, to make bearable, गुर्वपि विरहदुःखमाशाबंधः साहयति Sak.iv.With उद्-, to rouse, to encourage, आतस्थौ रथमात्मीयानुत्सिसाहयिषन्निव Bt.ix.69.
सह् (II) vt. or vi. 4P (pres. सह्यति) 1. To satisfy; 2. to be pleased; 3. to bear, to endure.
सह (I) a. (f. हा) 1. Bearing, suffering, enduring; 2. patient; 3. able, सा स्त्रीस्वभावादसहा भरस्य Mud.iv.
सह (II) m.n. Strength, power.
सह (III) m. The month of Mārgaśīrṣa.
सह (IV) ind. 1. With, accompanied by, united to, (used with an inst.), ननु तैलनिषेकबिंदुना सह दीपार्चिरुपैति
मेदिनी
म् R.i.38; 2. simultaneously, अनुकूलभावमथवा पराङ्मुखत्व सहैव नरलोके । अन्योन्यविहितमंत्रौ विधिदिल्लीवल्लभौ वहतः R.G.
सह (I) a. (f. हा) 1. Bearing, suffering, enduring; 2. patient; 3. able, सा स्त्रीस्वभावादसहा भरस्य Mud.iv.
सहा f. The earth.
सह-अध्यायिन् m. a fellow-student.
सह-अर्थ (I) a. synonymous.
सह-अर्थ (II) m. a common object.
सह-उक्ति f. 1. speaking at the same time; 2. a figure of speech (in rhetoric); (it is thus defined- सा सहोक्तिः सहार्थस्य बलादेकं द्विवाचकम् K.Pr.x.).
सह-उटज m. a hut made of leaves.
सह-उदर m. a uterine brother, a brother of whole blood.
सह-ऊढ m. the son of a woman pregnant at the time of marriage.
सहोढ m. A thief caught with stolen property.
सह-कार (I) a. having the sound ह, (i.e. the vocative particle), Nal.ii.14.
सह-कार (II) m. 1. co-operation; 2. a fragrant sort of mango, बद्धपल्लवतया उपभोगक्षमः सहकारः Sak.i.
सह-कार˚भंजिका f. a sort of game.
सह-कृत a. co-operated with, aided.
सह-गमन n. 1. the act of accompanying; 2. a woman’s burning herself with her deceased husband.
सह-चर (I) a. going with.
सह-चर (II) m. 1. a companion, a friend; 2. surety.
सह-चार m. 1. harmony, agreement; 2. the accompaniment of the middle term by the major (in logic).
सह-चरी f. 1. a female companion; 2. a wife.
सह-ज (I) a. 1. born together, innate, inborn; 2. inherent, natural.
सह-ज (II) m. 1. a brother of whole blood; 2. the natural state or disposition.
सह-ज˚मित्र n. a natural friend.
सह-ता f. association, union.
सह-त्व n. association, union.
सह-दार a. with a wife, married.
सह-देव m. the youngest of the five Pāṇḍava princes.
सह-धर्मचारिणी, -धर्मिणी f. a wife legally married.

सह-धर्मचारिन् m. a hushand.

सह-भाविन् m. a partizan, an adherent.
सह-भोजन n. eating together in company with friends.
सह-वसति f. dwelling together, सहवसतिमुपेत्य यैः प्रियायाः कृत इव मुग्धविलोकितोपदेशः Sak.ii.
सहन (I) a. (f. ना) Enduring.
सहन (II) n. Bearing, enduring, patience, forbearance.
सहन (I) a. (f. ना) Enduring.
साहन n. Sufferance, endurance.
सहस् (I) m. 1. The month Mārgaśīrṣa, Sis.vi.57; 2. the winter season.
सहस् (II) n. 1. Victory, strength, power; 2. lustre, brilliance.
सहसा ind. 1. Precipitately, without consideration, rashly, सहसा विदधीत न क्रियामविवेकः परमापदां पदम् Kir.ii.30; 2. on a sudden, at once, निशीथदीपाः सहसा हतत्विषो बभूवुः R.iii.15.

साहस n. 1. Violence, force, rapine, M.viii.385; 2. a felony; 3. oppression, cruelty, न सहास्मि साहसमसाहसिकी Sis.ix.59; 4. punishment, chastisement, fine, M.viii.138 (also m. in this sense); 5. boldness, daring, courage, a daring act, किमपरमतो निर्व्यूढं यत्करार्पणसाहसम् M.M.ix.
सहसान m. 1. A peacock; 2. a sacrifice, an oblation.
सहस्य m. The month Pausha, सहस्यरात्रीरुदवासतत्परा K.S.v.26.
सहस्र n. A thousand.
साहस्र (I) a. (f. स्री) 1. Relating to a thousand; 2. consisting of a thousand; 3. bought with a thousand; 4. paid per thousand (as interest); 5. thousand-fold.
साहस्र (II) m. An army of detachment consisting of a thousand men.
साहस्र (III) n. The aggregate of a thousand.

सहस्र-द m. an epithet of Śiva.

सहस्र-धार m. the discus of Viṣṇu.

सहस्र-वेध n. sorrel.

सहस्र-शस् ind. by thousands.
सहस्र-शिखर m. the Vindhya mountain.
सहस्रिन् (I) a. (f. णी) 1. Having a thousand; 2. consisting of a thousand, amounting to a thousand (as a fine), वैश्यं पंचशतं कुर्यात् क्षत्रियं तु सहस्रिणम् M.viii.376.
सहस्रिन् (II) n. 1. A body of a thousand men; 2. commander of a thousand.

साहाय्य n. Help, succour.
सहाय-ता f. 1. a multitude of companions; 2. companionship, union; 3. help, स किल संयुगमूर्ध्नि सहायतां मघवतः प्रतिपद्य महारथः R.ix.19.

सहाय-वत् a. 1. having a companion; 2. assisted, befriended.
सहार m. 1. Universal dissolution; 2. the mango tree.

सहिष्णु-ता f. 1. ability to support; 2. patience, resignation.

सह्य (I) a. (f. ह्या) 1. Powerful, strong; 2. endurable, tolerable; 3. to be endured, कथं तूष्णीं सह्यो निरवधिरिदानीं तु विरहः Ut.iii.; 4. able to bear, adequate to, equal to; 5. sweet, agreeable.
सह्य (II) m. One of the seven principal mountain ranges in India, that which forms the eastern boundary of the Konkana, असह्यविक्रमः सह्यं दूरान्मुक्तमुदन्वता (अलंघयत्) R.iv.52, Kir.xviii.5.
सह्य (III) n. 1. Health, convalescence; 2. assistance.
सह्य (I) a. (f. ह्या) 1. Powerful, strong; 2. endurable, tolerable; 3. to be endured, कथं तूष्णीं सह्यो निरवधिरिदानीं तु विरहः Ut.iii.; 4. able to bear, adequate to, equal to; 5. sweet, agreeable.
साह्य n. 1. Conduction, union, society; 2. aid, assistance.
साहचर्य n. Companionship, fellowship, company, association, एकत्र नो विद्यापरिग्रहाय नानादिगंतवासिनां साहचर्यमासीत् M.M.i., K.S.iii.21, R.xvi.87.

साहस-अध्यवसायिन् a. acting with inconsiderate haste.
साहस-कारिन् a. a peacock.

साहसिक (II) m. 1. A robber, a freebooter; 2. a desperado, या किल विविधजीवोपहारप्रियेति साहसिकानां प्रवादः M.M.i.

साहसिन् a. (f. नी) 1. Violent, ferocious; 2. bold, daring, impetuous.

साहायक n. 1. Assistance, aid, स कुलोचितमिंद्रस्य साहायकमुपेयिवान् R.xvii.5; 2. fellowship; 3. a number of associates, companions; 4. auxiliary troops.

साहित्य n. 1. Assosiation, combination, society, fellowship; 2. literary composition, rhetorical composition, साहित्यसंगीतकलाविहीनः साक्षात्पशुः पुच्छविषाणहीनः Bhartr.ii.12; 3. rhetoric, ars pœtica; 4. (according to some) a collection of materials for the production or performance of anything.
साह्य-कृत् m. a companion, an associate.
साह्वय m. Gambling with fighting animals.
